finding_key: packages/docs/src/model/document.ts::enter at offset 0 of a bulleted heading strands the remembered level on the empty leading bullet; the heading's text loses it (asymmetric with a plain heading)
evidence: Verified from the supplied packages/docs/src/model/document.ts: in splitBlock, a non-empty list-item always yields newType='list-item' (the heading-preserving branch only applies to title/subtitle/heading types), so Enter at offset 0 of a bulleted heading splits into a plain list-item carrying all the text. The PR's own docs (docs/design/docs/docs.md) and the new Yorkie split test confirm applySplitBlock drops headingLevel from the non-heading new half while the original block retains the memory — so at offset 0 the memory strands on the empty leading bullet and the heading text loses it, asymmetric with a plain heading which stays a heading. No test covers offset 0. I could not read applySplitBlock's actual body (empty checkout), hence medium confidence; but every readable line matches the claim. Impact is a narrow edge case that silently loses heading formatting, so minor.
